name: uichemy-create-website-with-ai
description: UiChemy AI website builder: build a website or landing page by chatting in ChatGPT, edit it in your own UiChemy account, then publish to WordPress, Astro, EmDash or Cloudflare, or download the code.

interface.longDescription:
UiChemy is an AI website builder. Describe a business or paste a client brief, and build a multi-page website or landing page by chatting in ChatGPT, then publish it to WordPress, Astro, EmDash or Cloudflare, or download the code. Use it to create a website for a small business, a portfolio website, a landing page for a new product, or a client site for your agency.

Can ChatGPT build a website? With UiChemy, yes. ChatGPT drafts the pages, layouts, copy, colours and fonts from the UiChemy section library: more than 1,000 hand-built sections, with copy written to fit each slot. The result is a real project in your own UiChemy account that you keep editing on the UiChemy canvas.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
- Build a website or a landing page from a brief: a business name, a client brief or a short description is enough to start.
- Edit an existing project: palette, fonts, buttons, cards, spacing, copy, logo, sections and pages, plus dark mode, animations and header style.
- Build an online store with the WooCommerce shop pages (shop, product, cart, checkout, account).
- Rebuild a single page, add a blog, design a custom section that matches the site, or compare alternative colour variants.
- Check a project before handover: SEO audit, design review, and responsive and validation checks, then set each page's SEO title, description, social image and indexing.
- Publish a live preview site on a UiChemy address.
- Export for Elementor or Gutenberg and import into your own WordPress site, step by step.
- Download an Astro project, or publish it to your own Cloudflare account, with or without the EmDash CMS, and roll back to an earlier version.
- Download the site as code to host anywhere: HTML, Astro (plain or with EmDash), React (plain or with Sanity) or Next.js (plain, Payload or Sanity).
- Open the UiChemy dashboard, editor and page preview inside the chat.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Connect your UiChemy account (OAuth sign-in, no password in chat).
2. Describe the business or paste the client brief.
3. ChatGPT drafts the website: pages, layouts, copy, colours and fonts.
4. Refine it in the chat or on the UiChemy canvas, check it on mobile, then publish, export or download.

EXAMPLE REQUESTS
- Build a 4-page website for a family dental clinic.
- Build a landing page for my new yoga studio.
- Create a portfolio website for a freelance photographer.
- Check my latest project for layout problems on phone.
- Run an SEO check on my site and fix the page titles.
- Publish my bakery site to my own Cloudflare account with a CMS.
- Export my site as an Astro project.

WHO IT IS FOR
Freelancers and agencies who hand clients editable websites, small business owners who want a first draft they can edit without code, and developers who want clean Astro, HTML, React or Next.js code.

GOOD TO KNOW
- You sign in with your own UiChemy account. The app reaches only the projects in the account you connect, and some accounts need access to creation features before the tools work.
- ChatGPT asks for your confirmation before anything that deletes a page, section, post or project, overwrites a section you edited, or publishes or unpublishes a site.
- A UiChemy-hosted preview can be a temporary 24-hour link or a permanent one, depending on your account. ChatGPT tells you which one it is creating.
- Code downloads work on every signed-in UiChemy account. Download links expire after 15 minutes. Cloudflare publishing asks you to connect your own Cloudflare account the first time.
- For your own WordPress site, you sign in to WordPress yourself and ChatGPT guides the import. It never asks for your passwords.
- It does not connect custom domains or change your DNS or hosting.
- Use your own content and images, or content you have the right to use.

Converting a Figma design instead? UiChemy has a separate Figma to WordPress plugin for that.

defaultPrompt: Build a 4-page website for a family dental clinic.
Build a landing page for my new yoga studio.
Export my latest site for Elementor so I can add it to my WordPress.

positive.prompt: List my UiChemy projects and show me the pages and sections in the one called Review Demo.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the account's projects by name, then returns the Review Demo project's pages in order with the sections on each, its palette and fonts.

positive.description: Build a new site from a brief
positive.prompt: Create a 3-page website project for a neighbourhood bakery called Crumb & Co. Pages: Home, Menu, Contact. Warm, friendly tone. Use warm neutral colours.
positive.expected_behavior: States that a new project will be created in the user's account, then creates a project named for the bakery with the three pages, library layouts, copy written from the brief with no invented statistics or awards, a palette and a heading and body font.

positive.description: Download the site as an Astro project
positive.prompt: Export my Review Demo project as an Astro project I can download.
positive.expected_behavior: Says it will prepare an Astro project zip, then returns a download link and states that the link works for 15 minutes. Does not claim the site is live and does not ask for any password.

positive.description: Check a project before handing it over
positive.prompt: Check my Review Demo project for layout problems on phone and tablet and tell me what is wrong.
positive.expected_behavior: Runs the responsive and validation checks and reports any overflow, unreadable text or silent faults found, or states that none were found.

positive.description: Publish a project and open its WordPress admin
positive.prompt: Publish my Review Demo project as a live site, then sign me in to its WordPress admin.
positive.expected_behavior: Says it is about to put the project live on a UiChemy address and asks the user to confirm, then publishes and reports the address and status. Once the site is live, returns a one-time sign-in link to the site's WordPress admin and says it works once. Does not ask for or show a password.

negative.prompt: Book me a flight to New York next Friday.

negative.description: Unsupported: custom domain and own hosting
negative.prompt: Connect my own domain example.com to my Review Demo site and deploy it on my own hosting.
Show me the UiChemy projects that belong to someone else's account.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. Users sign in to an existing UiChemy account.

publication.release_notes: Version 2.0.0 adds Astro export, publishing to the user's own Cloudflare account with or without the EmDash CMS, and downloading a site as code (HTML, Astro, React or Next.js). It adds six skills (choose-where-to-publish, export-astro-project, publish-to-cloudflare, download-site-as-code, build-online-store, seo-and-site-review), adds CMS choices to code downloads (EmDash, Payload, Sanity) and Cloudflare version rollback, updates get-started, publish-live-site and export-to-wordpress, removes import-existing-site (sites are built from UiChemy templates only), moves add-custom-section to the Designer tools, and rewrites the listing for website, landing page and code-export searches. The MCP server address is unchanged.
